name: Qingdao Hanhe Cable Co.,Ltd
summary: Qingdao Hanhe Cable Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, production, and sale of cables and wires in China. It offers power cables, bare wires, equipment cables, special cables, data cables, overhead lines, cable accessories, submarine cables, heat resistant and high strength aluminum alloy wires, fire-resistant and armored cables, and DC series cables. It also engages in cable development and research services; and manufacturing and sales of power testing equipment.
